significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish that a pre-contradiction mutability representation, "largely orthogonal to the truth-value direction," predicts an ordering in later revision resistance and causally controls that resistance when steered; this combines a form-(iii) predictive coupling/ordering with a form-(ii) mechanism. It would establish both a phenomenon—"beliefs internally tagged immutable resist updating far more than mutable ones, at matched evidence strength"—and a mechanism that fixes which beliefs should resist contextual correction, although it remains bounded mainly to belief revision rather than explaining multiple distinct behaviors. This matters to truth-probe and model-editing work represented by Marks and Tegmark's Geometry of Truth and ROME/MEMIT because it would separate truth status from expected editability; a clean negative result after matching confidence would instead rule out the distinct mutability-gating account, so true and false are determinate and informative states. Topic-substitution check: merely restating research on LLM beliefs would not justify this score; the pre-update predictive ordering, orthogonality, and causal reversal are the claim-specific reasons it is above the topic median.

reach.justification: The named handle is the "mutability readout," proposed to "route such facts to stronger evidence or heavier editing"; because it is read before correction is attempted and predicts subsequent resistance, it is an ex-ante screening and routing signal rather than merely a post-hoc explanation. After per-model re-extraction, the substantive prediction survives as a relation—higher immutable/essential readout should forecast lower revision plasticity at matched evidence strength—rather than transferring only a procedure for finding an unconstrained direction. The hypothesis speaks broadly about LLMs and essential versus accidental properties across real and synthetic kinds, and its downstream users include RAG, continual-maintenance, and knowledge-editing practitioners who could gate correction strategies, though it does not establish transfer to closed or substantially larger systems. Topic-substitution check: the topic alone supplies no such forecast or operational routing handle, so the reach score rests on the claim-specific pre-contradiction predictor and its asserted cross-domain relation.
